_doc: FEAT-255 (US-012, resolves PR-004) pinned-seed baseline fixture. Captured by driving the REAL res://MainScene.tscn composition root at seed=42 through exactly one END_TURN press (VerbBarView.press("END_TURN")), with every opened reaction_prompt_ui pop-up resolved via its own "none" option when offered. tests/regression/test_baseline_diff_regression.gd re-drives this IDENTICAL interaction and asserts every field below stays byte-identical -- zero deltas. UPDATED (FEAT-002, Iteration M P0-0): the prologue roster now seats Marigold as a second living, player-controlled combatant ("player_1") between Titus and the Skeleton in turn order. Titus still acts first at this seed, but a single END_TURN press now only ends Titus's OWN turn and hands control to Marigold (a second living player) -- RoundSession/TurnController only auto-drives AI (enemy) turns, never a second living player combatant -- so this one press no longer reaches the Skeleton's automated reaction/attack/turn-advance sequence at all. Re-captured from a real, fresh MainScene boot at seed=42 after the roster change (two independent boots confirmed identical output before pinning here).
